summary: Complaints centre on the Bhakra dam leak damaging roads and fields and on night power cuts, while residents credit a new bypass, rural roads, PHC medicines and better safety.

round2.changes: Verified all 7 distinct URLs by fetching them. Wikipedia extent confirmed: Bilaspur Tehsil is in the AC, so Bilaspur town (Bhakra dam, Ambedkar Park road) is inside it. Negative 1 (dam) reworded to what the 30 Sep report states (damaged about a month, fields and embankment threatened); the 20 Sep report is kept only for the Bilaspur leak and 40 m wall. Negative 3 replaced by the 16 Sep 2026 night power-cut memorandum (BKU Chaduni, dateline Bilaspur), which is recent and ongoing. Kamari college item removed (AC membership unconfirmed, not in Wikipedia extent). Farmer power/canal-water positive removed (canal water not found in the source). Added positive: 1 Oct 2026 chakroad encroachment cleared for farmers (Aurangnagar Khera, dateline Bilaspur). Rural-roads and women-safety basis rewritten to match the quotes checked. Old '19 hours power' item kept as rank 5 but flagged as a one-off May storm outage. Bypass retained with AC membership still unconfirmed. Fertilizer item kept (feature, Niranjan Singh).

positives.english: Village roads have improved and travel is easier now
positives.hindi: गांवों की सड़कें सुधरी हैं, अब आवागमन आसान है
positives.basis: Narendra Singh says roads were once a problem but connectivity is now good. Kalpana and Ganga Mehta praise road work. No village named in the feature.

positives.english: The bypass has given major relief from traffic jams
positives.hindi: बाईपास बनने से जाम से बड़ी राहत मिली है
positives.basis: Balwinder Singh calls the bypass a big gift for solving traffic jams. No town is named. AC membership of the bypass unconfirmed.

positives.english: Encroachment on a farm track was cleared, so farmers got relief
positives.hindi: चकरोड से कब्जा हटा, किसानों को खेत तक रास्ता मिला
positives.basis: Revenue team removed years-old encroachment on a chakroad (farm access track) in Aurangnagar Khera after farmers complained to the SDM; article says farmers get relief. Dateline Bilaspur; the village's AC membership is inferred from the Bilaspur dateline, not stated.

positives.english: Primary health centres now have doctors and medicines
positives.hindi: प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्र पर अब दवा और डॉक्टर मिल रहे हैं
positives.basis: Shyamal Mirdha says primary health centres now have enough medicines and doctors. Hamid Ali acknowledges better healthcare. PHC not named in the article.

positives.english: Women feel safer and law and order has improved
positives.hindi: अब महिलाएं पहले से ज्यादा सुरक्षित महसूस करती हैं
positives.basis: Kalpana and Ganga Mehta say women feel safer than before; Vivek Agarwal says law and order has improved. Feature story, no place named.

negatives.english: Bhakra dam has been damaged for a month and keeps leaking, threatening fields and embankment
negatives.hindi: भाखड़ा डैम महीने भर से खराब, रिसाव से खेत और बंधा खतरे में
negatives.basis: Report datelined Bilaspur (Rampur), 30 Sep 2026: dam damaged for about a month; each closure attempt fails and leakage restarts; nearby fields and embankment threatened. Dam is in Bilaspur town, inside Bilaspur Tehsil, which is in the AC (Wikipedia extent). 20 Sep report confirms the leak and a 40 m earth wall built inside the reservoir.

negatives.english: Road near Bhakra dam sank seven feet, leaving pits and damaged park steps
negatives.hindi: डैम के पास सड़क सात फुट धंस गई, गड्ढों से आना-जाना मुश्किल
negatives.basis: Report datelined Bilaspur (Rampur), 9 Sep 2026: road near Bhakra dam sank about seven feet and Ambedkar Park steps were damaged; residents blame continuous seepage from the reservoir. Later report (30 Sep): two large potholes on the dam road are disrupting traffic. Bilaspur town is inside the AC.

negatives.english: Villages get power only one to two hours at night, farmers protest
negatives.hindi: रात में गांवों में एक-दो घंटे ही बिजली मिलती है
negatives.basis: BKU (Chaduni) workers sat in protest at the Ashoknagar substation on the Nainital highway; their memorandum says the 33 kV feeder fails at night so rural areas get 1-2 hours of power. Demand: stop night cuts. XEN assured quick resolution. Dateline Bilaspur, 16 Sep 2026. Allegation as stated by the union. Ashoknagar's AC membership not separately confirmed; Bilaspur dateline used.

negatives.english: Small farmers do not get full fertilizer allotment because of documentation issues
negatives.hindi: छोटे किसानों को पूरी खाद नहीं मिलती, कागज़ात की दिक्कत है
negatives.basis: Farmer Niranjan Singh says small farmers often cannot get the full fertilizer quota because of incomplete registration or land records. Feature story, no village named (district-level applicability).

negatives.english: Power stayed off for 19 hours in Bilaspur after a storm
negatives.hindi: आंधी के बाद बिलासपुर में 19 घंटे तक बिजली गुल रही
negatives.basis: District power-cut report, 2 May 2026, with a section headed 'Bilaspur: power stayed off for 19 hours'. Trees fell on the industrial line near Mullakheda; supply to dozens of villages restored Friday about 2 PM, per SDO. One-off storm outage; Mullakheda's AC membership not confirmed.

notes: Verified in this round: Wikipedia AC page (no 36, reserved None, Rampur district). Extent is Bilaspur Tehsil plus Sihari and parts of Milak tehsil (Nagla Udai, Shyampur, Khata Kalan, Dhanaili Uttri, Pashupura), so Bilaspur town is inside the AC. Sources are still mainly one Amar Ujala feature (2 Sep 2026). Searches for a Bilaspur (Rampur) bypass report, a Kamari degree-college report and a Bilaspur Ambedkar Park report found nothing new; the bypass location is still unconfirmed. Kamari dropped because its AC membership is unconfirmed. Not used: Oct 9-10 2026 hailstorm (villages Nawabganj, Jafarabad, Sihora etc. not located in the extent); Bilaspur road-accident report (22 Sep); Himachal Bilaspur items; Rudrapur and Kichha (outside AC). Field check recommended on dam leak status, bypass location, night power cuts at Ashoknagar substation, and whether the 19-hour outage area is in the AC.
